dataItems: TOTAL QBREADER DATABASE: 352,153 total questions (190,173 Tossups + 161,980 Bonuses).
TOTAL HISTORY CATEGORY: 74,679 History questions (40,807 Tossups + 33,872 Bonuses) — 21.21% of all QBReader questions.
EUROPEAN HISTORY SUBCATEGORY: 24,826 questions (13,376 Tossups + 11,450 Bonuses) — 33.24% of History.
1. "FRENCH" IN HISTORY (Question + Answer): 5,125 questions (2,416 Tossups + 2,709 Bonuses) = 6.86% of all History (20.64% of European History, 1.46% of entire DB).
2. "FRENCH" OR "FRANCE" IN HISTORY (Question + Answer): 8,068 questions (4,102 Tossups + 3,966 Bonuses) = 10.80% of all History (32.50% of European History, 2.29% of entire DB).
3. STRICT ANSWERLINE ONLY ("French" or "France" in the Answerline): 1,075 questions (496 Tossups + 579 Bonuses) = 1.44% of all History (0.79% for "French" alone: 590 questions).
